events.name: Bash
events.head: Check task state, chain step, and welcome wiring

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find welcome wiring and probe usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "enrolWelcome\|welcome_enrolled" cloud/src | cut -c1-160 | head -20; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Map reminders exports and callers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "^export \(async \)\?function" cloud/src/reminders.ts | head -30; grep -rn "from \"./reminders\"\|from './reminders'" cloud/src | cut -c1-200; grep -rn "rotat\|revoke" cloud/src/reminders.ts | head -8 | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find reminders call sites
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "remindersEnrolOne\|remindersTick\|reminders\." cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/calendar.ts cloud/src/invites.ts cloud/src/jobs-*.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-180 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how chain starts a local centre and sim
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/run-chain.sh | cut -c1-220; ls app/scripts | grep -i "local-centre\|centre-local\|start" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find private local centre helper
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts cloud/scripts | grep -i "lane\|private\|stack" ; grep -rln "8960" app/scripts cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head

events.text: Starting a private local centre and vendor-sim to re-run the reminders probe myself.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check dev runner and sim port options
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | cut -c1-200 | head -30; grep -n "PORT\|argv\|environ" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private vendor-sim and centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; lsof -ti:8960,8882 | head; P=/tmp/t228v; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for centre and sim to come up
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8960/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "[1-5]" && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8960/admin/enter; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8882/; tail -3 /tmp/t228v/centre.log; ls migrations 2>/dev/null | tail -2; grep -n "migrations_dir\|database_name" wrangler.jsonc | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply migrations and run reminders probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t228v/state --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tail -3; cd ../app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 timeout 600 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t228v/probe.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t228v/probe.log; grep -E "FAIL|skip|SKIP" /tmp/t228v/probe.log | head; tail -2 /tmp/t228v/probe.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run reminders probe on private stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t228v/probe.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t228v/probe.log; grep -E "FAIL|skip|SKIP" /tmp/t228v/probe.log | head; tail -2 /tmp/t228v/probe.log

events.text: Probe passed 93/0; now checking the calendar-link rotation lines and the live workspace read-only.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check rotation results and stop private stack
events.input: $ grep -iE "revok|new calendar|feed|contact" /tmp/t228v/probe.log | grep -v "^PASS  their" | cut -c1-170 | head -8; kill $(cat /tmp/t228v/centre.pid) $(cat /tmp/t228v/sim.pid) 2>/dev/null; /bin/sleep 1; ps -p $(cat /tmp/t228v/centre.pid),$(cat /tmp/t228v/sim.pid) -o pid= | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm private centre port is free
events.input: $ curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8960/admin/enter; ps ax -o pid,command | grep -E "workerd.*8960|8960" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-120 | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find read-only mailbox listing route
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "email-accounts\|mailboxes" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-180 | head -8; grep -rn "email-accounts" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-052.json 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-300 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how sender mailbox is looked up
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "senderId\b" -A7 cloud/src/reminders.ts | sed -n 1,9p | cut -c1-200; grep -n "/admin/api/reminders" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-160 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live reminder status read-only
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "\"/admin/api/[a-z/-]*reminder[a-z/-]*\"" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-170 | head; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/reminders 2>&1 | head -c 900

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find accounts proxy and go-live sender guard
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "\`/accounts\|\"/accounts" cloud/src/*.ts | cut -c1-170 | head -5; grep -n "RULED\|ruled\|SENDER" app/scripts/e2e-tantra-reminders-live.mjs | head -6 | cut -c1-200
